raw_segments.text: Juliet, O bid me leap rather than marry Paris from off the battlements of yonder tower or
walk in thievish ways, or bid me lurk where serpents are, chain me with roaring bears,
or hide me nightly in a charnel house or covered quite with dead men's rattling bones,
with reaky shanks and yellow chapless skulls, or bid me go into a new-made grave and hide
me with a dead man in his shroud, things that, to hear them told, have made me tremble, and
I will do it without fear or doubt to live an unstained wife to my sweet love.
